biography: Clive Hayes, a 23-year-old hailing from a small village in the English countryside, wasn't born into racing royalty. His father was a mechanic, and Clive spent his childhood tinkering with engines in their garage. His first taste of speed came on a beat-up kart his dad pieced together, tearing around local tracks and quickly developing a reputation for his fearless overtakes. A defining moment came during a regional karting championship when, despite starting last after a mechanical failure, he clawed his way to victory, showcasing his raw talent and aggressive driving style. This victory caught the eye of MCR S2000, who offered him a junior driver contract. Now, in his second season with the team, Hayes is making waves, proving he's more than just a flash in the pan, and his relentless pursuit of victory is turning heads in the paddock. He is known for pushing his car, and himself, to the absolute limit.
drivingStyle: Hayes' driving style is a potent mix of aggression and calculated risk. He's known for late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes, often pushing his car to the very edge of its capabilities. While some criticize him for being reckless, his ability to extract every last ounce of performance from his machine is undeniable. Tire management isn't his strong suit, often sacrificing longevity for immediate gains. Under pressure, Hayes tends to become even more aggressive, either leading to spectacular results or costly mistakes.

rivalries.reason: A clash of egos developed after a controversial incident where Hayes forced Alvarez off the track during a crucial race, costing Alvarez valuable championship points.
Rossi, a veteran driver, publicly criticized Hayes' aggressive driving, calling him 'a danger to himself and others,' sparking a heated exchange in the media.
Hayes and Tanaka are often neck and neck on the track, with several photo-finishes between them. The rivalry is fueled by mutual respect, but also a fierce desire to prove who is the faster driver.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, even if they're full of holes.
Listens to heavy metal music at full volume right before a race to get 'pumped up'.
Has a specific routine of meticulously cleaning his driving gloves before each session, claiming it 'aligns his focus'.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the Silverstone S2000 Race in torrential rain, showcasing exceptional car control and overtaking prowess to claim his first major victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the Brands Hatch race due to a mechanical failure, costing him a guaranteed win and valuable championship points.
